difference: Only the last print media block changed after Cow. Templates, fixtures and screen CSS are identical. QX rechecked all 20 scenes, final real 1024/1280 views, and print.
notes: An earlier browser API viewport override did not resize the background tab (actual 1366); rejected as narrow-screen evidence and replaced by CDP metrics with actual widths 1024 and 1280.
One sampling call timed out and reset the session before samples were persisted. The completed routes were measured again with per-iteration persistence.
A premature new-tab inventory read returned no new tab; next tool turn confirmed the native tab and content. This was harness sequencing, not a missing detail route.
Initial print samples 1134/796/771/750/803ms failed the 1000ms gate. Print-only pagination was corrected and a fresh tab produced 972/782/810/807/807ms.
Known post SLA current/finished-late conditions are synthetic unit scenarios only. No unconfirmed SLA was added to real prototype fixtures.
